From 5e2b291be4a997a16f35771bda96b5ac77835d9c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dominik Leonhardt <dominik.leonhardt@schmidt24.de>
Date: Tue, 19 Nov 2019 16:33:23 +0100
Subject: [PATCH 1/3] Add polyfills for IE11

---
 .browserslistrc   | 2 ++
 babel.config.js   | 8 +++++++-
 package-lock.json | 6 ++++++
 package.json      | 1 +
 src/klaro.js      | 8 ++++++++
 webpack.config.js | 4 +++-
 6 files changed, 27 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 .browserslistrc

diff --git a/.browserslistrc b/.browserslistrc
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..a02e49cc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.browserslistrc
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+last 2 version
+not dead
diff --git a/babel.config.js b/babel.config.js
index c23a080c..3c9041fc 100644
--- a/babel.config.js
+++ b/babel.config.js
@@ -1,7 +1,13 @@
 // This is the configuration file for babel
 /* eslint-env node */
 module.exports = {
-    presets: ["@babel/preset-env", "@babel/preset-react"],
+    presets: [
+        ["@babel/preset-env", {
+            useBuiltIns: "entry",
+            corejs: 3,
+        }],
+        "@babel/preset-react"
+    ],
     plugins: [
         "@babel/plugin-proposal-object-rest-spread"
     ]
diff --git a/package-lock.json b/package-lock.json
index 37eb4e83..7c6c2a83 100644
--- a/package-lock.json
+++ b/package-lock.json
@@ -2186,6 +2186,12 @@
       "integrity": "sha1-Z29us8OZl8LuGsOpJP1hJHSPV40=",
       "dev": true
     },
+    "core-js": {
+      "version": "3.4.1",
+      "resolved": "https://registry.npmjs.org/core-js/-/core-js-3.4.1.tgz",
+      "integrity": "sha512-KX/dnuY/J8FtEwbnrzmAjUYgLqtk+cxM86hfG60LGiW3MmltIc2yAmDgBgEkfm0blZhUrdr1Zd84J2Y14mLxzg==",
+      "dev": true
+    },
     "core-js-compat": {
       "version": "3.3.3",
       "resolved": "https://registry.npmjs.org/core-js-compat/-/core-js-compat-3.3.3.tgz",
diff --git a/package.json b/package.json
index 2ae3b0ec..9b60f025 100644
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
@@ -32,6 +32,7 @@
     "@babel/preset-env": "7.6.3",
     "@babel/preset-react": "7.6.3",
     "babel-loader": "8.0.6",
+    "core-js": "^3.4.1",
     "cross-env": "^6.0.3",
     "css-loader": "^3.2.0",
     "current-executing-script": "^0.1.3",
diff --git a/src/klaro.js b/src/klaro.js
index 1c1bcaf1..f93ad765 100644
--- a/src/klaro.js
+++ b/src/klaro.js
@@ -4,6 +4,14 @@ import 'scss/klaro.scss'
 // React Dev Tools browser extension.
 if(module.hot) require('preact/debug')
 
+import "core-js/modules/es.array.iterator";
+import "core-js/modules/es.array.from";
+import "core-js/modules/es.map";
+import "core-js/modules/es.set";
+import "core-js/modules/es.symbol";
+import "core-js/modules/es.symbol.iterator";
+import "core-js/modules/es.promise";
+
 import React from 'react'
 import App from 'components/app.js'
 import ConsentManager from 'consent-manager'
diff --git a/webpack.config.js b/webpack.config.js
index 156c3392..be4530bc 100644
--- a/webpack.config.js
+++ b/webpack.config.js
@@ -98,7 +98,9 @@ if (APP_DEV_MODE === 'server') {
           target: 'http://localhost:5000/',
           secure: false
         }
-      }
+      },
+
+      disableHostCheck: true
     },
     plugins: [
       ...config.plugins,

From 91f1a709a3eae416c1b6a686fd1055277e131f38 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dominik Leonhardt <dominik.leonhardt@schmidt24.de>
Date: Wed, 20 Nov 2019 17:46:00 +0100
Subject: [PATCH 2/3] Removes .browserslistrc to fall back to 'defaults' and
 comment for importing polyfills

---
 .browserslistrc | 2 --
 src/klaro.js    | 1 +
 2 files changed, 1 insertion(+), 2 deletions(-)
 delete mode 100644 .browserslistrc

diff --git a/.browserslistrc b/.browserslistrc
deleted file mode 100644
index a02e49cc..00000000
--- a/.browserslistrc
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,2 +0,0 @@
-last 2 version
-not dead
diff --git a/src/klaro.js b/src/klaro.js
index f93ad765..66d1ff30 100644
--- a/src/klaro.js
+++ b/src/klaro.js
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@ import 'scss/klaro.scss'
 // React Dev Tools browser extension.
 if(module.hot) require('preact/debug')
 
+// This polyfills are needed for IE11 compatibility
 import "core-js/modules/es.array.iterator";
 import "core-js/modules/es.array.from";
 import "core-js/modules/es.map";

From 885347481eac466dbc1d68a6d64028435d525c02 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dominik Leonhardt <dominik.leonhardt@schmidt24.de>
Date: Wed, 20 Nov 2019 19:22:13 +0100
Subject: [PATCH 3/3] Replaces useBuiltIns: "entry" with "usage"

---
 babel.config.js | 2 +-
 src/klaro.js    | 9 ---------
 2 files changed, 1 insertion(+), 10 deletions(-)

diff --git a/babel.config.js b/babel.config.js
index 3c9041fc..57d784dc 100644
--- a/babel.config.js
+++ b/babel.config.js
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
 module.exports = {
     presets: [
         ["@babel/preset-env", {
-            useBuiltIns: "entry",
+            useBuiltIns: "usage",
             corejs: 3,
         }],
         "@babel/preset-react"
diff --git a/src/klaro.js b/src/klaro.js
index 66d1ff30..1c1bcaf1 100644
--- a/src/klaro.js
+++ b/src/klaro.js
@@ -4,15 +4,6 @@ import 'scss/klaro.scss'
 // React Dev Tools browser extension.
 if(module.hot) require('preact/debug')
 
-// This polyfills are needed for IE11 compatibility
-import "core-js/modules/es.array.iterator";
-import "core-js/modules/es.array.from";
-import "core-js/modules/es.map";
-import "core-js/modules/es.set";
-import "core-js/modules/es.symbol";
-import "core-js/modules/es.symbol.iterator";
-import "core-js/modules/es.promise";
-
 import React from 'react'
 import App from 'components/app.js'
 import ConsentManager from 'consent-manager'
